components.description: HERRAGA red trim plate; always the WhatsApp action.

components.css: .ds-lights { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 2.5rem; padding: 1.6rem; background: #08303f; } .ds-lights span { width: 3rem; height: 1rem; border-radius: 999px; background: radial-gradient(60% 90% at 50% 35%, #ffd27a, #ffb22e 55%, #b86d00 100%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #2b3a40, 0 0 0 3px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.25), 0 0 18px 4px rgb(255 178 46 / 0.55), 0 6px 40px 10px rgb(255 178 46 / 0.25); animation: ds-ignite 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; animation-delay: calc(180ms + var(--i) * 110ms); } @keyframes ds-ignite { 0% { filter: brightness(0.25) saturate(0.4); } 35% { filter: brightness(1.6); } 100% { filter: brightness(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-lights span { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The page is the front of a Mexican tractocamión, read top to bottom: amber clearance lights on the roof, a chrome nameplate headline over a radiator grille of chrome slats, a chrome bumper carrying engine brands, then the cab side and its mud flaps. Every surface is a material that exists on a decorated Mexican truck: cab-paint navy, white cab paint, black mud-flap rubber, polished chrome, HERRAGA red and amber lamp glass. Nothing is a generic "card"; containers are plates, bezels, flaps and emblems.

Sections alternate between dark cab paint (header, hero, brands, footer), black rubber (the engine catalog), white cab paint (pillars, products, branches) and solid HERRAGA red (the quote form). Density is workshop-legible: big condensed type, large tap targets (3.25rem buttons), short copy. Chrome is the jewelry; it sits on lettering, trim and bezels, and the eye reads it as metal because every chrome gradient reflects a horizon (bright sky, dark horizon line, warm ground).

The world explicitly refuses the stock parts-store template: dark hero with truck photo and an icon-card grid.
keyCharacteristics: Truck materials, not UI chrome: every container is a nameplate, bezel, mud flap, emblem or bumper.
Horizon-reflection chrome in three strengths, chosen by whether it carries lettering.
Condensed uppercase display type for every heading; highway-sign Barlow Condensed for labels and buttons.
Amber is light: lamps, focus, active switches, matches, and links on dark paint.
Every section ends near a WhatsApp action; red is the color of that action.

rules.name: The Lettering Decides the Chrome Rule
rules.body: If a chrome surface carries text, it uses the text-bearing plate (`--chrome-h`). If it carries none, it uses the trim bar (`--chrome-bar`). The trim bar's dark horizon line would cut straight through lettering.

rules.name: The Red Means WhatsApp Rule
rules.body: A red button opens WhatsApp. The only other red primary in the build is the newsletter submit, which itself falls back to WhatsApp when no list provider is configured; nothing else gets the red plate.

rules.name: The Amber Is Light Rule
rules.body: Amber appears where a lamp would glow or where something is switched on: lights, focus, the active switch, search matches, links on dark paint. It is never a background field.

rules.name: The Live Text Rule
rules.body: Chrome lettering is decorative SVG with `aria-hidden`; the same words exist as real heading text. Text never lives only in an image.

rules.name: The All-Caps Display Rule
rules.body: Every h1–h4 is uppercase Big Shoulders at 850+. Sentence case belongs to body copy and ledes only.

rules.name: The Light From Above Rule
rules.body: Highlights sit on top edges, shade on bottom edges, and cast shadows fall down. A shadow cast sideways or upward breaks the material.

rules.name: The Recessed Panel Rule
rules.body: A dark panel on a light or red field sits inside a polished bezel; it is mounted on the truck, not floating over it.

dos: Do build every new container from a truck material: chrome plate, bezelled dark panel, mud-flap rubber, emblem, bumper band.
Do pick chrome by content: `--chrome-h` under lettering, `--chrome-bar` on bare trim.
Do keep heading text in the DOM when it is drawn as chrome lettering.
Do end each section near a red WhatsApp button, and prefill the message with the engine or part when known.
Do use amber for anything lit, focused, selected or matched.
Do keep motion short and eased (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`, 160–380ms for state, up to 1100ms for the hero entrance), and let `prefers-reduced-motion` collapse it.
donts: Don't use the stock parts-store template: a dark hero with a truck photo and a grid of icon cards.
Don't put lettering on the full-strength trim bar or the raw lettering horizon at small sizes; its dark horizon line breaks legibility.
Don't use the red primary button for anything that is not the WhatsApp channel.
Don't use amber as a background field or a large fill.
Don't cast shadows sideways or upward; light comes from above.
Don't put essential text inside images.
